scope: calibration 1960-1969 and internal validation 1970-1978 only; hold-out and reserved values are forbidden
index_rule: For index targets, compute each model year's annual aggregate and normalize it to the model's own 1960 aggregate, multiplied by 100. This is a declared scale normalization, not a fit; do not adjust the model to match the target.
tolerance_policy: Absolute residual threshold is fixed from published rounding precision before comparison, never tuned to fit residuals.

C1 produces exports in 1960-1964, so a model-own-1960 base exists, but national_accounts.exports falls to zero from 1965 through 1985Q4. build_export_demands scales the declared requests by Treasury payable cash; the export path therefore remains financially constrained and the requested non-binding export comparison is not available. No export target was fed back as demand.
